understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete each level by moving the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable simultaneously; doing this for all levels would win the whole game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each turn you control one selected piece ('P') and can MOVE in four directions on a grid where cells correspond to 3-pixel steps in the provided [x,y] coordinate system. Walls ('#') and boundaries can prevent movement, while some objects (e.g., blocks 'B') are pushable when directly adjacent in the movement direction so they slide along with the selected piece if space allows. Levels can have multiple selectables ('S'), and CLICK with an exact pixel position switches control to the selectable at that coordinate; the movement_blocked flags are only hints about adjacent objects and don’t guarantee a move will fail.
